apps.name: Pocket City 2+ (Apple Arcade)
apps.localizedDescription:
Create roads, zones, landmarks, special buildings, and live the life of a successful mayor!

In this unique City Building game you can drop your avatar into the world and roam freely!! Do typical Mayor things like:
• Buy, customize and hang out in your own mansion
• ADOPT A PET! Your pet follows you around the city! 
• Get your pilot license and fly a stunt plane
• Manage police, fire, education, taxes and other policies to ensure your city remains stable! 
• Become an undercover police officer
• Prove yourself in STREET RACING
• Ball out in the BASKETBALL CHALLENGE
• Create your own startup company
• Throw money (or tomatoes) at your citizens
• "Borrow" cars without asking
• Drive off ramps into the air
